args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 unhealthy in production; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all three production regions with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: All regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production.
3. **Verified**: The service is now healthy in all regions, with the error rate down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: Created a SEV2 incident (INC-0001) for checkout-api, which paged the on-call engineer, describing the failure and the rollback action taken.
